plant.description: The path to place the branches on.

offsetSingle.description: Moves every second branch up toward the next one, 1 makes pairs

lowestBranch.description: How low should the branches start. 0 is the bottom, 1 is the top.

highestBranch.description: How high should the branches start. 0 is the bottom, 1 is the top.

depth.description: On how many layern of branches should we place branches.

amount.description: The amount of branches to generate.

resolution_curve.description: The resolution of a branch as long as the longest path, shorter branches get fewer points.

angle.description: Upward tilt of branches. 0 = horizontal, positive = upward, negative = drooping.

taper.description: How much the thickness tapers to the tip. 1 = a cone, 0 = the thickness input alone sets the profile.
